title: Compare proposals and hire
summary: Pick the right provider and pay safely.

steps.headline: Waiting for proposals
steps.body: Providers near you send proposals. You will get a notification.
steps.narration: Providers near you will send proposals. You get a notification when one arrives. There is no need to wait by your phone.

steps.headline: Proposals
steps.body: Open Proposals to see every provider who applied.
steps.narration: Open the job and tap Proposals to see every provider who applied.

steps.headline: View profile
steps.body: Check their rating, reviews and photos of their work.
steps.narration: Tap View profile to check a provider's rating, reviews and photos of their work.

steps.headline: Hire
steps.body: Happy with a proposal? Tap Hire.
steps.narration: When you like a proposal, tap Hire. Take your time to choose.

steps.headline: Confirm and hire
steps.body: Review the summary, then tap Confirm and hire.
steps.narration: Check the summary, then tap Confirm and hire.

steps.headline: Pay online
steps.body: Pay with GCash, Maya, card or online banking.
steps.narration: You pay online with GCash, Maya, a card or online banking. It is quick and secure.

steps.headline: Held until done
steps.body: TaskBuddy holds your payment and releases it only when you confirm the job is done.
steps.narration: TaskBuddy holds your payment and releases it only when you confirm the job is done. So you stay in control.

steps.headline: Message your provider
steps.body: Tap Message to agree on the details.
steps.narration: Once hired, tap Message to chat with your provider and agree on the details.
